annotation.title_clean: NPC Advisory No. 2024-04: Guidelines on the Application of Republic Act No. 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012, its Implementing Rules and Regulations, and the Issuances of the Commission to Artificial Intelligence Systems Processing Personal Data
annotation.title_en: NPC Advisory No. 2024-04: Guidelines on the Application of the Data Privacy Act of 2012 to Artificial Intelligence Systems Processing Personal Data
annotation.summary_en: Philippine National Privacy Commission advisory applying the Data Privacy Act 2012 to AI systems processing personal data in development, training, testing and deployment. It sets requirements on transparency, accountability, fairness, accuracy, data minimization, lawful basis and data subject rights, including human intervention in automated decisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Data Privacy Act applies to AI development and deployment, including training and testing
Controllers must explain AI purpose, inputs, risks, outputs and dispute mechanisms
Governance mechanisms: privacy impact assessments, privacy-by-design, AI ethics board, continuous monitoring
Meaningful human intervention and contestability for significant automated decisions
Bias monitoring and prohibition of AI washing; publicly available data remains protected
